result:
Japanese is in place with a header language switcher. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (10 tests, 7 of them new), and `guren check --i18n` reports both catalogs covering all 29 keys. Nothing was committed.

Things you might not expect:

- **Header label change:** the "write a post" link now reads "New post" in English instead of "Write", because `posts.new` also serves as the new-post page heading.
- **New Home link:** the header gained a Home link for `nav.home`, next to the existing brand link to `/`.
- **Redirect on a foreign `Referer`:** a same-origin or relative `Referer` is used as sent; one from another origin is reduced to its path on this site, so the endpoint never redirects off-site. If the acceptance run sends a `Referer` with a different host and expects it echoed back verbatim, that case will differ.
- **Audit ignore:** `guren audit` warned that `POST /locale` has no authentication check. I recorded that as a deliberate ignore with a reason in a new `config/audit.ts`, since the route is meant to be open to guests.
- **Not translated:** server-side validation messages (e.g. "Title is required.") and the Home, auth, dashboard and profile pages are still English; the request only named the header and posts pages.

**Summary of changes:** `src/app.ts` now supports `en` and `ja` from a shared, dependency-free `config/locales.ts`, so the framework's own detection (locale cookie, then `Accept-Language`) drives `_i18n`. `POST /locale` is registered in `routes/web.ts` as `locale.update` with a body schema from `app/Http/Validators/LocaleValidator.ts`, so an invalid or missing locale fails through the same route-contract validation as the post form. `app/Http/Controllers/LocaleController.ts` stores the pick in a one-year `locale` cookie and redirects back to the `Referer` or `/`. Catalogs live in `lang/en/` and `lang/ja/` as `nav.json`, `posts.json`, `auth.json`, `locale.json` and `messages.json`, with all nine required keys and their Japanese values. `resources/js/components/Layout.tsx` and the four pages under `resources/js/pages/posts/` now read every label through `useTranslation()`, and the layout holds the switcher. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated with `bun run codegen`, and the new tests are in `tests/LocaleController.test.ts`.
